description: CarGene answers questions about the history of Japanese cars from a curated database: which generations of a model were sold and when, their chassis codes, the engineers who developed them, how generations relate (successor, sibling, derivative), and sales figures by country and year. Each fact comes with the source it was taken from. Read-only, no account needed.

defaultPrompt: Who was the chief engineer of the AE86 Corolla Levin?
List the generations of the Nissan Skyline with their chassis codes and sales years.
How many Toyota Corollas were sold in Japan in 2011?
